content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've been trying to configure a [product_name] using [product_name] [version_no]. The network test is successful when I connect, but accessing the device online to configure additional parameters is not possible, and error messages appear as shown in the attachments. Could someone assist me? Kind regards, [user_name]
It seems you have the latest [product_name] hardware. For this, you will need [product_name] [version_no]. Are you unable to download any programs to your new [product_name] hardware?
Hello, You must change the device type from the standard version to the correct hardware revision. Click the text at the bottom right to select the appropriate type.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing connection and configuration issues due to a mismatch between older software and newer hardware modules. Successful network testing is followed by failure to configure the device online, likely caused by software version compatibility problems and incorrect device type settings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable integration and compatibility between configuration software and hardware, aiming to easily connect and adjust parameters on the device using the corresponding software.
